answer: One workable design: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because pearl only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, beacon is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
